rationale: Compound noun with feminine possessive ⲡⲉⲥ- 'her.' Etymology of ⲥⲁⲕⲡⲟ unclear; possibly ⲥⲁⲕ 'draw, drag' + ⲡⲟ (action-noun?). Found in cosmological context of conveyance through the Zone. Flagged for parallel research.
Possibly Lycopolitan reflex of ϩⲟⲣⲟⲧⲉ 'fear' with regular ϩ→ⲍ and ⲣ→ⲗ. Alternative: a noun of cyclical/circuit motion fitting the Zone-context. Flagged for parallels.
Possibly stative form of ⲃⲱⲗ 'release' (cf. accumulated ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ); could also relate to ⲃⲱϣ 'be naked, stripped.' Plural -ⲟⲩ suggests collective. Confidence low.
Indefinite ⲟⲩⲏⲓ̈ 'a house' + ⲛ̄ϣⲉ 'of wood.' In context: the First Man is structured 'in the manner of a house of wood' — the multi-membered cosmic body as a tree-built dwelling.

ⲡⲉⲧ- ('the one which') + ⲍⲏⲡ ('hidden,' qualitative of ϩⲱⲡ 'hide'). Substantival use: 'a hidden one' / 'a hidden thing,' the dwelling-place of the blessed Man parallel to image, form, love, virgin in the same series.
